title: Stochastic and Noisy Oracles in Smooth Continuous Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.41086v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We review models of inexact computational oracles in smooth continuous optimization and their implications for the convergence, computational complexity, and attainable accuracy of optimization algorithms. We adopt a framework in which zeroth-,first-, and second-order oracles are characterized by quantitative error bounds and may accept additional control parameters that influence both their accuracy and computational cost. We introduce deterministic and stochastic oracle models and illustrate their properties through a variety of examples, including finite-difference approximations, stochastic gradients, and randomized derivative estimators. Particular attention is given to the distinction between absolute and relative errors, bias and variance, and stochastic function evaluations with independent or coupled randomness. translated_title: 光滑连续优化中的随机与噪声预言机
translated_abstract: 我们回顾了光滑连续优化中不精确计算预言机的模型，及其对优化算法的收敛性、计算复杂度和可达到精度的影响。我们采用一个框架，其中零阶、一阶和二阶预言机由定量误差界来刻画，并且可以接受同时影响其精度和计算成本的额外控制参数。我们引入了确定性和随机预言机模型，并通过多种例子说明其性质，包括有限差分近似、随机梯度和随机化导数估计器。综述特别关注绝对误差与相对误差的区别、偏差与方差的区分，以及具有独立或耦合随机性的随机函数评估。本综述的一个核心主题是利用共同的分析工具来推导和比较不同预言机模型下的收敛性与复杂度。
tldr: 本综述提出了一个统一框架，用定量误差界刻画光滑连续优化中的零阶、一阶和二阶不精确预言机，并借助共同的分析工具比较各类确定性与随机预言机模型下算法的收敛性与复杂度。
en_tdlr: This review proposes a unified framework that characterizes zeroth-, first-, and second-order inexact oracles in smooth continuous optimization via quantitative error bounds, and uses common analytical tools to compare the convergence and complexity of various deterministic and stochastic oracle models.
